about_the_game:
A desktop widget program that can import male/female models and motion files. Supports the Steam Workshop.

MMD Player

  • Supports importing VMD format

  • Compatible with Mixamo's FBX for Unity (*.fbx) files

  • Drag and drop motion files onto models to apply

Music Import

  • Supports MP3/WAV audio files

  • Automatically binds motions to models after importing

Model Controls

  • Left or middle mouse button to drag models

  • Eyes follow the mouse cursor

  • Mouse wheel to zoom in/out

  • Right-click for context menu

Includes a stylish default character.
